page.description: Premiere luxury villa care and property management firm based in Nice, serving private families and real estate agencies from Cannes to Monaco. Specialising in bespoke services for high-end estates, we ensure every detail is managed with the utmost care and professionalism. Discover how our tailored approach can enhance your life on the Riviera, maintaining and elevating the value of your home.

Villa & Apartment Services
Year-Round Care for Your Home
Ongoing maintenance and oversight, so your apartment or villa runs smoothly, even when you're away.
From keyholding and security checks to garden care and managing repairs, we keep everything in perfect order behind the scenes.
Stress-Free Arrivals & Secure Departures
Show up to a home that feels like you never left.
We handle pre-arrival cleaning, groceries, fresh linens, flowers, even airport pickups. When you leave, we button everything down with the same care.
Effortless Living with On-Demand Services
Private chefs, trusted drivers, and everything in between.
From full household staffing to bespoke concierge requests, we tailor each detail to your preferences, quietly and expertly.
Expertly Trained Staff on Land and Sea
Professional training and trusted placements for villas and yachts.
We offer discreet, hands-on training in service, housekeeping, and guest experience designed for real-world excellence. Need a butler, housekeeper, or steward(ess)? We source, place, and polish top-tier talent.
Pre-Season Maintenance. Pre-Arrival Preperations. Year Round Care.
With over fifteen years serving private families and three decades in luxury hospitality, I understand that owning your home on the French Riviera should be a joy, not a burden. That's why our team provides a comprehensive range of property care and concierge services designed to take the hassle out of owning and visiting your fabulous vacation property, your home away from home, your well deserved retreat. 
From meticulous property upkeep to managed lifestyle services, we ensure your home is always ready for you and your guests, allowing you to relax and enjoy your time while you’re in town, knowing everything is in good hands while you’re away. Whether you own a townhouse, apartment or a villa with gardens, Major Domo has a service tier right for you. Welcome to our website, I hope you find the information you need and we’re always here for a phone call. 
~ David Weyn, Founder
Year-Round Property Care
Our property management services are designed to maintain your property to ultra high standards, ensuring your home remains in perfect condition year-round.
Our Property Management Services Include:
Routine Property Care: Luxury property management includes scheduled and routine property inspections, preventive maintenance and repairs, and renovation project management to keep your estate in top condition.
Home Readiness and Security: Secure key holding, property ventilation, opening, and cleaning, lawn and pool care, along with security system coordination.
Complete Administrative Handling: Mail collection and management, utility meter monitoring, and comprehensive administrative management including local regulation compliance.
Learn More
“To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that is sincerity and integrity.” 
— Douglas Adams
Pre-Arrival Preparations
We ensure that your arrival and departure are seamless and stress-free, so you can relax and enjoy your home from the moment you arrive. 
Our Arrivals & Departures Services Include:
Prepared and Personalized Welcome: Pre-arrival deep cleaning, setup of summer kitchens and pool furniture, and a 5-star welcome that includes fresh linens, toiletries, and elegant flower arrangements.
Gourmet and Lifestyle Ready: Gourmet food and beverage provisioning selected to your preferences, including curated sommelier wine and champagne selections to ensure your stay starts luxuriously.
Seamless Transitions: VIP and airport transfers and comprehensive post-departure cleaning and lockup, allowing you to effortlessly arrive and depart with everything managed to perfection.
